audience_job: decide, before merging, whether an agent's 'fixed' claim has actually been verified
experiment_variable: opening line: the agent's quoted claim versus a plain statement
label: SOURCE_ANALYSIS

theses.thesis: A 'fixed' claim is unverified until a fresh command and its exit code exist
theses.evidence: the upstream skill file requires proof of completed work from a fresh verification command and its actual output, including exit status
theses.counterexample: a passing suite that never reproduced the original failure proves that suite is green, not that the bug is gone
theses.reader_action: paste the exact command and its exit code into the pull request before merging

theses.thesis: Agent confidence and agent evidence arrive in the same tone, so the log is the only distinction
theses.evidence: the same summary sentence carried a correct and an incorrect fix in this trial with no change in wording
theses.counterexample: a one-line typo correction needs no log, and demanding one there trains people to skip the cases that matter
theses.reader_action: require the raw log only for claims that change behaviour

theses.thesis: Selling an AI verification report service now would be premature
theses.evidence: this draft records no paying customer, no price and no qualified demand for such a report
theses.counterexample: a team already paying a manual QA reviewer has both the budget and the pain today
theses.reader_action: run one paid pilot before building any report product

red_team: Objection: reviewers already ask for a passing test. Answer: they ask for a summary, and the requirement here is the exit code from a fresh run, which a pasted summary cannot carry.
Objection: a screenshot of the run is enough. Answer: a screenshot is not recheckable by the next reader and does not survive review; the command and its exit status do.
Objection: this collapses on flaky suites. Answer: it does, and that is the useful part -- a flaky suite is exactly why a green summary is not proof.

parts:

No run = unverified fix.
